description: This file defines the SchemaController class within the SuiteCRM API v8 namespace. It handles HTTP requests to serve JSON schema files and Swagger documentation, reading from specific files and returning their contents. It extends an ApiController and manages exceptions related to file access and processing.

classes.name: SchemaController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for serving API schema files and Swagger documentation in JSON format, handling exceptions related to file access.

methods.name: getJsonApiSchema
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to fetch the JSON API schema file, reading the file specified by the JsonApi class, and returning it in the response. Throws exceptions if the schema file cannot be found or read.

methods.name: getSwaggerSchema
methods.description: Handles HTTP request to fetch the Swagger JSON schema from a fixed file path, returning its contents in the response or throwing exceptions if the file cannot be accessed.
